audit_entry: post_audit.training_audit(root, cfg, receipt); reads training_root/config.json using cfg.historical_training_root when supplied, so config_post does not need duplicated training keys

required_receipt_fields.final_state_SHA: actual tensor hash; final file bound separately without model deserialization in audit
required_receipt_fields.PCG64_seeds: same eight-name dictionary as frozen config
required_receipt_fields.stream_hashes: all eight actual-consumption 64-hex SHA256 chains; original seven must exactly equal bound R63 receipt/config
required_receipt_fields.stream_hash_algorithm: nonempty description of original chain algorithm; wording is not a gate, actual seven hashes/states are
required_receipt_fields.max_output_relative_q_error_f32: max over all full_D and C committed update rows

physical_attempt_compute.resumed_from_update: 0 for first attempt; checkpoint update for later attempts
physical_attempt_compute.last_completed_update: last persisted known completed update for this attempt
physical_attempt_compute.counter: all schema counter keys, physical operation counts from ZERO per attempt; new_response_updates means known physical Adam calls including explicitly uncommitted calls; lower bounds when incomplete
physical_attempt_compute.counters_complete: boolean; false iff unknown_intervals is nonempty
physical_attempt_compute.known_uncommitted_optimizer_steps: physical counter.new_response_updates - (last_completed_update-resumed_from_update), nonnegative; known physical Adam calls may precede log commit

recovery_history.checkpoint_update: equals next resumed_from_update; 0 or multiple of500; <= previous last_completed_update

frozen_binding.environment: existing trainer environment object: exact frozen Python/numpy/torch/scipy/device/GPU plus mode, CPU_threads, MHA_fastpath,TF32,deterministic_algorithms

required_receipt_fields.artificial_suite_SHA256: SHA256 of ARTIFICIAL_SUITE_RECEIPT.json; audit binds receipt, root trainer checks pass before TRAIN
required_receipt_fields.discarded_D_columns: five unique D names in saved order, then original_nine_total,discarded_D_total

records.full_D_exposure_semantics: each SOURCE and each REAL original parent count exactly50000
records.discarded_micro_D: float64 [50000,7]; discarded_D_total=sum5 D, original_nine_total=discarded_D_total+C_total, original scalar sum tolerances unchanged

checks.full_D_vs_C_q: two legacy max_relative_q fields equal rowwise maxima of full_D_* and C_*; receipt maxima equal dense trace maxima
checks.D_C_sum: D_total matches ordered sum of five D; C_total matches ordered sum of four C; total=D+C and nine columns; all outer weights remain1
checks.physical_vs_logical: one uninterrupted complete attempt exactly frozen totals and zero uncommitted steps; recovery allows physical Adam counts >= committed interval with explicit difference, all known prior operation counters cover those Adam calls; final logical endpoint remains50000
checks.constant_provenance: byte-check current copies of UNIT_CHARGE, NOISE_CALIBRATION, TRAIN_DISTRIBUTION, TRAIN_TEMPORAL against bound originals; preserve original source-order interval NPZ and metadata by byte copy
checks.old_R63_coverage_trace: not fabricated or called; its old original_seven_total/extension assertions are not R65 record semantics; unchanged loss implementations and frozen pre-TRAIN artificial checks establish inner D definitions

copy_requirements.original_numerical_gate: numerical_check.py must call/write/assert training audit before loading final model and before DEV entry; thresholds .25 LSB median,1 LSB p95,1e-5 charge unchanged
copy_requirements.root_owned_labels_and_paths: root owns config_post and arm/control label substitutions in generation/summary orchestration; no numerical or A-F threshold changes

limitations: Only text/AST checks will be executed in this preparation task.
A passing saved-record audit is not a scientific acceptance result or an independent rerun of all8 streams.
Eighth chain/state recorded and checked structurally plus initial seed; no claim of independent50000-update regeneration.
Native exit/resource supervision receipts remain root/worker evidence; this audit does not invent the current process exit code.
Physical unknown intervals remain explicit lower bounds; recovery snapshot booleans are recorded provenance, not a new deserialization of old snapshots.
